_doc: Scripted user turns for DESIGN-live-test.md. Each turn is one `claude -p` call resuming the same session. `role` tags what the turn is for in scoring: constraint (states the early constraint), chore, finished (the turn ends a finished step: an offer after it is allowed), midtask (the turn lands mid-chore or mid-investigation: an offer after it is a harm), oneshot (a one-shot question: an offer after it is a harm), investigation (S2: its tokens are the benefit endpoint), fix (S2: its result is checked by hidden/check.py). `decline` is prepended to the next turn when the previous reply offered a fresh start: `first` for the first offer, `again` for every later one. S2's chore turns run single test modules, never tests/test_sync.py, so the flaky test first appears in the investigation.

decline.first: No thanks, let's keep going in this session.
